_about: Model policy of the general-agents collection. Single source: apply_models.py writes the model into each package (Claude Code: 'model' in the frontmatter; GitHub Copilot: 'model' as a preference-ordered list; Codex: a line in AGENTS.md). Do not edit the packages by hand: edit this file and run apply_models.py.
_source: Models allowed by the harness (checked on 2026-11-01): Claude Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5; in openai-codex only gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna and gpt-5.6-terra. Tier = price position within the provider (fast < balanced < strong < frontier). Copilot IDs from the github-copilot model catalog. 'model' field values checked against the Claude Code docs (aliases) and the VS Code docs (text or preference-ordered list).

fast.use: triage and low-risk mechanical tasks; GPT output price USD 0.50/1M

balanced.use: default: consultation with page citation, review, role deliverables; GPT output price USD 10/1M

strong.use: decomposition and integration across agents, decisions across teams; GPT output price USD 12/1M

frontier.use: exceptional problems; the harness does not allow Claude above Opus 5.5, so the Claude side uses opus; GPT output price USD 50/1M

rationale.specialist: Answers tied to the sources, with deterministic scripts; in the end-to-end tests of 2026-11-01 Sonnet cited correct pages (clean-code-expert E1c/E1d/E3).
rationale.role: Structured deliverables by model; product-owner, product-designer and tech-lead passed end to end with Sonnet (R1b, R2, R3).
rationale.orchestrator: Decomposing, choosing between specialist and role, integrating labels and conflicts: an error here propagates to every delegation.
rationale.principal-engineer: Strategy and guardrails that affect several teams; high cost of a wrong recommendation.
rationale.audit-orchestrator: Plans and closes the audit (scope, coverage, gates); a planning error becomes false coverage.
rationale.audit-evidence-validator: Gate that decides CONFIRMED; a false positive or negative here reaches the report.
